texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Beef Sticks are made of tasty beefhide and delicious beef meat for intensive, long-lasting chewing fun. While keeping your dog busy, the natural abrasive action of chewing helps remove tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked, free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added GMOs or gluten. Pack of 3 sticks, 75 g.
texts.feeding_instructions: XS dogs (1–5 kg): feed 1 treat over a course of seven days; do not exceed 1 treat in a seven day period. S–L dogs (5+ kg): feed 1 treat over a course of two days; do not exceed 1 treat in a two day period. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Always provide fresh water and supervise your dog while chewing.
